preparation.operation: recover exactly six large chroma-separated components, attach only nearby meaningful fragments, order them by row and centroid, key and decontaminate magenta, fit each component without upscaling into a 512px safe cell, and align contact pixels to one baseline

strengths: The six silhouettes form one unusually coherent masonry, timber, iron, and ember-light family.
The elevated camera, material rendering, forge-light direction, doorway aperture, and collision-readable bases are visually consistent.
Every requested component is present with no actor, UI, text, ground plane, or extra standalone item.
failures: The backdrop is a generated near-magenta field rather than the required literal #ff00ff source key.
The wall, forge, barricade, and bench cross their declared equal-cell boundaries and do not retain the required 12 percent cell padding.
Both lanterns are authored at almost the same source-pixel height as the forge, contradicting the requested shared physical scale even though runtime metadata can shrink them.
The north wall reads as a standalone ruined gate rather than a safely repeatable wall module with clear continuation seams.
Prepared edges retain small red-purple spill flecks around rubble, making promotion unsafe without another deterministic cleanup contract.
review.decision: Quarantine this one-shot candidate as positive coordinated-art evidence and negative ingress evidence. Do not copy it into production atlases or runtime manifests.
